title: What is the ‘Android Pulse’ app that just appeared in Google Play Store updates?
summary: On Saturday morning, you might have noticed an app called “Android Pulse” appearing in the list of available Google Play updates. It’s curious that Google did not use its dedicated System Services approach to update this kind of app.
